race.comment: SOTOMAYOR (3) is the one to beat after going under by only half a length at Hamilton, where he was well-supported favourite and was pipped late after travelling into the race strongly. His Warrnambool BM62 seventh prior was still only beaten two and a half lengths, so the recent form reads well enough for this. Some gear tweaks should help. RAMELLE (5) is the main danger after a head second at Hamilton, building on her Mortlake Mdn win over 1100m when she beat Classy Sassy by a length and a half. MISTY EMOTIONS (6) has improvement to come second-up after finishing fifth at Hamilton, and her record around 1300m has her in the mix if she sharpens from that run. AQUAHOLIC (1) returns after a spell of three months. Started the last campaign impressively when in the placings over 1200m at this track. Hasn't scored when fresh from a break but generally races well and comes here with definite top-three claims.
